title: Synthetic Test Collections for Retrieval Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Categorizing Information Retrieval (IR) systems based on their underlying language models (e.g., GPT, T5, or traditional methods) and comparing their retrieval performance (NDCG@10) on real test collections versus synthetic test collections generated by specific LLMs, to determine if the synthetic collections unfairly favor systems utilizing the same LLM.
